primary_functional: SARC: exact homogeneous LDA + one full inverse-response-difference kernel
field_normalization: zero mean and unit RMS; phases and amplitudes fixed before exact nonuniform calculation
new_hypothesis: SARC Euler defect and density error are second order; within-functional relaxation penalty is fourth order. Removing tail returns first, first, second order when the linear mismatch is resolved.
energy_caveat: Relaxation penalty compares two densities in the SAME candidate functional. It is not the candidate-minus-exact ground-state energy error.
